title: Local-Channel Stability of Classical $\mathbb Z_2$ Lattice Gauge Models
summary: We establish sufficient conditions for two-way local quantum-channel stability in classical $\mathbb Z_2$ lattice gauge models with spins on $m$-dimensional cells of a $d$-dimensional lattice. Each interaction multiplies the spins on the boundary of an $(m+1)$-cell. This family, defined on the full spin Hilbert space without a Gauss-law constraint, includes the Ising model at $m=0$ and the magnetic sector of the toric code at $m=1$.
